page.overview:
Who is Le Novar?

Le Novar is a character created by author J. B. Lee for his Cthulhu Mythos writings. He was first made mention of in the 1998 short story "Genuine Article".

Le Novar claims to be a cosmic time-travelling alien from Xandra the Asteroid Planet, currently occupying the body of a human being - an elderly black man named Nick Calvert - although whether this is actually the case is uncertain. He is the author of the fictional book The Stars Are With You!, a "paperback mishmash of [Erich] von Daniken, Madame [Helena] Blavatsky and H. P. Lovecraft", in which he reveals the truth of his origin.

Le Novar owns an artefact, dubbed the Clawed Crystal, which allows its user to travel through space and time, and even to affect events in the past. He has also been shown to be willing to loan the Crystal to others in exchange for favours, as seen when he allowed Robert Clarke the use of its abilities in exchange for the theft of a manuscript from Miskatonic University.

Despite there being no mention of Xandra the Asteroid planet in the works of Lovecraft, Le Novar being a body-swapping, time-and-space travelling alien suggests that he may be of the Great Race of Yith.
